//===== NEED Phase 0.32 - runtime verifier + perf harness ===================
//= TEST ONLY. GENERATED by p32_runtime.py. Registers nothing, changes nothing.
//============================================================================

-	script	NEED Phase32 Verify	-1,{
	end;

OnInit:
	debugmes "[P32] ---- verifier start ----";

	// ---- no-RID: the new commands must be callable from OnInit ----
	// A needtr() here would always have returned Korean (no player attached).
	// These calls carry BOTH strings and let each recipient pick, so a timer
	// or an instance event can now serve a mixed audience correctly.
	mapannouncelang "sec_pri", "[P32] no-RID KR", "[P32] no-RID EN", bc_map;
	areaannouncelang "sec_pri", 0, 0, 50, 50, "[P32] area KR", "[P32] area EN", bc_map;
	debugmes "[P32][NORID] mapannouncelang + areaannouncelang returned from OnInit with no attached RID";

	// ---- fixed per-call cost, measured on an empty map ----
	// gettimetick(0) is the SYSTEM TICK in milliseconds. Type 1 is
	// seconds-since-midnight and far too coarse for a per-call figure.

	freeloop(1);
	.@t0 = gettimetick(0);
	for ( .@i = 0; .@i < 1000000; .@i++ ) { mapannounce "sec_pri", "KR", bc_map; }
	.@old = gettimetick(0) - .@t0;
	.@t0 = gettimetick(0);
	for ( .@i = 0; .@i < 1000000; .@i++ ) { mapannouncelang "sec_pri", "KR", "EN", bc_map; }
	.@new = gettimetick(0) - .@t0;
	freeloop(0);
	debugmes "[P32][PERF] mapannounce old=" + .@old + "ms new=" + .@new + "ms iterations=" + 1000000;

	freeloop(1);
	.@t0 = gettimetick(0);
	for ( .@i = 0; .@i < 1000000; .@i++ ) { areaannounce "sec_pri", 0, 0, 50, 50, "KR", bc_map; }
	.@old = gettimetick(0) - .@t0;
	.@t0 = gettimetick(0);
	for ( .@i = 0; .@i < 1000000; .@i++ ) { areaannouncelang "sec_pri", 0, 0, 50, 50, "KR", "EN", bc_map; }
	.@new = gettimetick(0) - .@t0;
	freeloop(0);
	debugmes "[P32][PERF] areaannounce old=" + .@old + "ms new=" + .@new + "ms iterations=" + 1000000;

	// npctalk / unittalk need a source with a real map, so the timing for
	// those two runs on the placed NPC below (a floating `-` script has
	// m = -1 and an AREA send from it measures nothing).
	donpcevent "NEED Phase32 Perf::OnRun";

	debugmes "[P32] ---- verifier done ----";
	bindatcmd "p32", "NEED Phase32 Verify::OnAtP32", 99, 99;
	end;

OnAtP32:
	// Run on ONE client. A working filter shows exactly one line per surface.
	dispbottom "[P32] need_lang=" + getneedlang() + "  (use @needlang 0 / 1)";
	.@m$ = strcharinfo(3);

	// 1. mapannounce - one buffer per recipient already, language per recipient
	mapannouncelang .@m$, "[P32-1 mapannounce] 이 줄은 한국어입니다.", "[P32-1 mapannounce] This line is English.", bc_map, "0x00FF99";

	// 2. AREA npctalk - two buffers, filtered sends
	npctalklang "[P32-2 npctalk AREA] 이 줄은 한국어입니다.", "[P32-2 npctalk AREA] This line is English.";

	// 3. AREA unittalk - the surface Phase 0.31 found unclassified
	unittalklang getcharid(3), "[P32-3 unittalk AREA] 이 줄은 한국어입니다.", "[P32-3 unittalk AREA] This line is English.";

	// 4. areaannounce
	areaannouncelang .@m$, 0, 0, 500, 500, "[P32-4 areaannounce] 이 줄은 한국어입니다.", "[P32-4 areaannounce] This line is English.", bc_map, "0xFFFF00";

	// 5. bc_self regression - the single-recipient fast path, unchanged
	npctalklang "[P32-5 npctalk bc_self] 한국어", "[P32-5 npctalk bc_self] English", "", bc_self;
	unittalklang getcharid(3), "[P32-6 unittalk bc_self] 한국어", "[P32-6 unittalk bc_self] English", bc_self;

	// 6. single-recipient needtr regression - must be unaffected
	dispbottom needtr("[P32-7 dispbottom needtr] 한국어", "[P32-7 dispbottom needtr] English");
	end;
}

// A PLACED npc on an empty map, only so npctalk/unittalk have a source with
// a real map id for the fixed-cost timing. It talks to nobody: sec_pri has
// no players, which is exactly the 0-recipient case being measured.
sec_pri,50,50,4	script	NEED Phase32 Perf	4_M_01,{
	end;

OnRun:
	freeloop(1);
	.@t0 = gettimetick(0);
	for ( .@i = 0; .@i < 1000000; .@i++ ) { npctalk "KR"; }
	.@old = gettimetick(0) - .@t0;
	.@t0 = gettimetick(0);
	for ( .@i = 0; .@i < 1000000; .@i++ ) { npctalklang "KR", "EN"; }
	.@new = gettimetick(0) - .@t0;
	freeloop(0);
	debugmes "[P32][PERF] npctalk old=" + .@old + "ms new=" + .@new + "ms iterations=" + 1000000;
	end;
}
